responsibility: Implements GCC’s classic RTL common subexpression elimination engine for extended basic blocks, centered on expression hashing plus register quantity-number tracking to replace computations with cheaper equivalent registers or constants. The file owns the main cse_main-driven optimization, condition-code specific cleanup, and the three pass entry points cse1, cse2, and cse_local, including jump simplification fallout, dead-insn cleanup, and limited post-pass CFG rebuilding when CSE turns conditional or computed jumps into simpler forms.
